rationale: The held 41 FR 26849 text confirms EO 11925 (1976-06-29): its one paragraph substitutes 'September 30,1978' for 'June 30, 1976' in EO 11554 as amended. The held 43 FR 42727 text of EO 12082 section 1-103 (1978-09-19) revokes 'Executive Order Nos. 10616, 11151, 11437, and 11554, as amended', with no delay or savings clause, so the sole clause ended on 1978-09-19, before its own substituted date. The decision says honestly that EO 12082 does not name EO 11925 and why the revocation reaches it anyway. The number searches found no earlier end, the basis is the acting text rather than the editorial notes, and the gaps are honest, so the NO is consistent and supported.
